chapter.verse: Cenchrea khua pawlpi upa khat ahi i sanggamnu Phoebe phatna thu, note' tungah kong sung nuam hi.
Amah pen mi tampite leh keimahmah a hong panpih khat ahih manin note in mi siangthote' gamtat ding kilawm bangin Topa' min tawh amah na sang unla nomau' kiangpan ama' kisap peuhpeuh na vaihawmsak un.
Khris Jesu' sungah ka naseppih Prisca leh Aquila na hopihsak un.
Amaute in kei' nuntak nadingin luangkham ngam uh ahih manin amau' tungah lungdam ka ko a, kei bek hilo, Gentile pawlpite khempeuh in zong lungdam ko uh hi.
Amau' inn-a a kikhawm pawlpi zong na hopihsak un. Asia gam panin Khris' lamah a palpen ahi ka it Epaenetus na hopihsak un.
Note' adingin nasep nakpi-in a hahkat Mary na hopihsak un.
Ka mipih leh ka thongkiatpih Andronicus leh Junias na hopihsak un. Amau pen kei sangin Khris a um masate uh hi a, sawltakpite in zong a na limtheihte ahi uh hi.
Topa' sungah ka it Ampliatus na hopihsak un.
Khris' sungah ka naseppih Urbanus leh ka it Stachys na hopihsak un.
Khris sungah a muanhuai Apelles na hopihsak un. Aristobulus ii innkuanpih teng zong na hopihsak un.
Ka mipih Herodion na hopihsak un. Topa' sunga om Narcissus ii innkuanpih teng na hopihsak un.
Topa' sunga nasemte ahi Tryphena leh Tryphosa na hopihsak un. Topa' sungah nasep a hahkat ka it Persis na hopihsak un.
Topa' sungah teeltuam Rufus leh, kei' adingin zong nu khat mah ahi, a nu na hopihsak un.
Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas leh amau' kianga om sanggamte na hopihsak un.
Philologus, Julia, Nereus leh a sanggamnu-a kipan Olympas leh amau' kianga mi siangtho khempeuh na hopihsak un.
Siangtho kinapna tawh khatlekhat na kihopih un. Khris' pawlpite khempeuh in note hong hopih uh hi.
Sanggamte aw, na zaksa uh hilhcianna tawh a kilehbulh, lungsim kikakna leh palkhaktheih thu a piangsak mite na kidop ding uh kong hanthawn nuam hi. Tuate peel un.
A hang pen tua bang mite i Topa Khris' nasem hilo-in amau' gilpi vai a sem uh hi a, amaute in kamkhum kamzol leh phatbawlna kam tawh thu tello mite' lungsim khemzo uh hi.
Thumang na hihna uh mi khempeuh in hong theihpih ahih manin note' hangin ka lungdam a, ahi zongin thuhoih lamsang ah lungpilin thusia lamsang ah mawhbaanglo na hih ding uh kong deih hi.
A sawt lo-in Pasian' nopna lemna thupha in note' khe nuai-ah Satan tuancil ding hi. I Topa Jesu Khris' hehpihna in note hong ompih ta hen.
Ka naseppih Timothy in note hong hopih hi. Ka mipihte ahi Lucius, Jason, leh Sosipater in zong hong hopih uh hi.
Hih laikhak a gelh keimah Tertius in Topa' min tawh note kong hopih hi.
Kei leh pawlpi bup ii inntek ahi Gaius in note hong hopih hi. Khuapi thuvanpa Erastus leh i sanggampa Quartus in zong note hong hopih hi.
(Note' tungah i Topa Jesu Khris' hehpihna hong om ta hen. Amen.)
Tu-in note hong thakhauhsak thei ahi Pasian in kong tangkokhiat Lungdamna Thu leh Jesu Khris' thu tawh ahi zongin, a tawntunga ki-imcip thusim hinapi tu-in a hong kilaakkhia thu—

ki-imcip himah taleh upna hangin thumanna a om nadingin tawntung Pasian' thupiakna tawh hong kilangkhia-in kamsanna laibute tungtawnin minam khempeuh' tungah a kigenkhia thu—tawh ahi zongin note hong thakhauhsak ding ahih manin
amah bek a pil ahi Pasian in Jesu Khris tungtawnin minpha ngah tawntung ta hen. Amen.
